steps.en: Check if the hirer got the electronic reminder or opted out
steps.id: Cek apakah hirer sudah dapat reminder elektronik atau opt-out
steps.why_en: The reminder job is switched off in every environment and the 2nd letter does not wait for its result.
steps.why_id: Job reminder dimatikan di semua environment dan 2nd letter tidak menunggu hasilnya.

steps.en: Hirers with an NRIC at the 2nd reminder stage go to the MHA check
steps.id: Hirer ber-NRIC di tahap reminder ke-2 dikirim untuk cek MHA

steps.en: Hirers with a FIN or company number are checked through the data source
steps.id: Hirer ber-FIN atau perusahaan dicek lewat sumber data
steps.why_en: This check is switched off in production settings, and hirers with a passport are not covered at all.
steps.why_id: Pengecekan ini dimatikan di pengaturan production, dan hirer ber-passport tidak tercakup sama sekali.

steps.en: The checked address and details replace the old ones on the notice
steps.id: Alamat dan data hasil cek menggantikan data lama di notice

steps.en: Due, unsuspended hirer NOPOs are queued for the 2nd letter
steps.id: NOPO hirer yang sudah diperbarui, jatuh tempo, dan tidak disuspend masuk antrean 2nd letter
